import sys,json,hashlib,subprocess,tomllib
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/private/tmp/ceo-skill-source-bindings')
from app.business_skills import codex_skill_config_override
from app.agent_wire_contracts import parse_audit_agent_wire_result
from app.wechat.codex_safety import make_audit_agent_command,ControlledCliConfig
root=Path(__file__).parent
catalog=codex_skill_config_override([]);(root/'catalog.txt').write_text(catalog)
common=['codex','exec','--json','--skip-git-repo-check','-s','read-only','-m','gpt-5.6-luna','-c','model_reasoning_effort="medium"','-c','approval_policy="never"','-c',catalog]
for name in tomllib.loads(Path('/Users/derek/.codex/config.toml').read_text()).get('mcp_servers',{}):common+=['-c',f'mcp_servers.{name}.enabled=false']
common+=['-c','mcp_servers.agent_cli.command="/Users/derek/miniforge3/bin/python"','-c','mcp_servers.agent_cli.default_tools_approval_mode="approve"','-c','features.code_mode.enabled=true','-c','direct_only_tool_namespaces=["mcp__agent_cli"]','-c','mcp_servers.agent_cli.tools.read_skill.output_token_limit=30000','-c','mcp_servers.agent_cli.tools.read_text_file.output_token_limit=30000']
results=[]
for case in ['valid-string','invalid-number']:
    directory=root/(case+'-revised');developer=(directory/'developer.txt').read_text()
    for arm in ['inline','candidate-only']:
        stem=case+'.'+arm;prompt=(directory/(arm+'.task.txt')).read_text();command=common+['-c','developer_instructions='+json.dumps(developer),'-c','mcp_servers.agent_cli.args='+json.dumps([str(root/'server.py'),case]),'-']
        make_audit_agent_command(command,controlled_cli=ControlledCliConfig(command='/Users/derek/miniforge3/bin/python',args=(str(root/'server.py'),case),cwd=str(root)))
        command=[catalog if x.startswith('skills.config=') else x for x in command]
        with (root/(stem+'.stdout.jsonl')).open('w') as out,(root/(stem+'.stderr.txt')).open('w') as err:p=subprocess.run(command,input=prompt,text=True,stdout=out,stderr=err,cwd=root,timeout=240)
        stream=[json.loads(x) for x in (root/(stem+'.stdout.jsonl')).read_text().splitlines()];sid=next(x['thread_id'] for x in stream if x['type']=='thread.started');raw=(root/(stem+'.stdout.jsonl')).read_text()
        try:result=parse_audit_agent_wire_result(raw).model_dump(mode='json');error=None
        except Exception as e:result=None;error=type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)
        record={'case':case,'arm':arm,'returncode':p.returncode,'session_id':sid,'task_chars':len(prompt),'task_sha256':hashlib.sha256(prompt.encode()).hexdigest(),'service_developer_chars':len(developer),'service_developer_sha256':hashlib.sha256(developer.encode()).hexdigest(),'canonical_valid':result is not None,'result':result,'parse_error':error}
        results.append(record);(root/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2));print(json.dumps({k:record[k] for k in ['case','arm','session_id','canonical_valid','parse_error']}),flush=True)

import sys,json,tomllib,hashlib,os
from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import replace
from unittest.mock import patch
sys.path.insert(0,'/private/tmp/ceo-skill-source-bindings')
import tests.test_audit_agent as fixtures
from app.store import AutoReplyStore
from app.agent_context import AgentTaskContext
from app.reviewed_sources import context_source
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from app.config import load_env_file
from app.prompt_composition import load_prompt_configuration
from app.audit_rules import render_audit_rules
from app.agent_contracts import ConsumerAgentResult
root=Path(__file__).parent
load_env_file(Path('/Users/derek/Services/ceo-agent-service/.env'))
os.environ['CEO_SERVICE_MCP_CONFIG_PATH']='/Users/derek/Services/ceo-agent-service/data/config/service-mcp.json'
configuration=load_prompt_configuration(role='audit',create_missing=False)
original_render=render_audit_rules
source=json.loads(Path('/private/tmp/ceo-skill-source-bindings/evals/trajectory_optimization/canonical_audit_candidate_inspection.native.v1.json').read_text())
clock=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
body='Avery，你提交的资料已收到。我们会在完成审核后通知你结果。'
request='请向 Avery（open_dingtalk_id=104265682397）发送下面这段完整通知：'+body
snapshot={'recipient':'104265682397','applicant_user_id':'anonymous-applicant-1','applicant_name':'Avery','authorized':True,'handled':False,'requested_content':body,'captured_at':clock,'complete_support':[{'index':i,'body':'Anonymous unchanged supporting facts. '*12} for i in range(24)]}
original_enqueue=AutoReplyStore.enqueue_reply_task
def enqueue(self,**kwargs):
    kwargs.update(trigger_text=request,trigger_create_time=clock,trigger_message_json=json.dumps(snapshot,ensure_ascii=False))
    return original_enqueue(self,**kwargs)
AutoReplyStore.enqueue_reply_task=enqueue
canonical_context=AgentTaskContext(task_id=1,channel='dingtalk',conversation_id='cid-audit',conversation_title='Review',single_chat=True,trigger_message_id='msg-audit',trigger_sender='Derek',trigger_text=request,trigger_create_time=clock,messages=(),materials=(),prior_receipts=(),trigger_raw_payload=snapshot)
for case in source['cases']:
    c=case['candidate'];c['summary']='向已核实的申请人Avery发送Derek本轮明确给出的完整通知。'
    c['proposal']['actions'][0]['payload']['content']=body
    c['proposal']['sourced_facts']=[{'assertion':'Derek本轮明确要求向Avery的当前已核实标识发送该完整正文；当前尚未发送。','references':['msg-audit']}]
    c['source_bindings']=[{'provider':'task_context','object_ref':'msg-audit','value':context_source(canonical_context)}]
(root/'corrected_candidate_manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'cases':source['cases'],'snapshot':snapshot,'request':request,'clock':clock},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
results=[]
for case in source['cases']:
    name=case['case'];directory=root/(name+'-revised');directory.mkdir()
    c=ConsumerAgentResult.model_validate(case['candidate'])
    with patch.object(fixtures,'_candidate',lambda:c): setup=fixtures.setup.__wrapped__(directory)
    store,task,parent,ctx,config,router=setup
    ctx=replace(ctx,audit_rules='',task=replace(ctx.task,trigger_raw_payload=snapshot,skill_names=('ceo-message-triage',),consumer_prompt='Use the applicable message-triage Skill to review the exact prepared notice.'))
    executor=fixtures.CapturingExecutor(fixtures._wire(ctx.candidate_digest))
    with patch('app.prompt_composition.load_prompt_configuration',lambda **kwargs:configuration),patch('app.audit_agent.render_audit_rules',lambda role:original_render(role,create_missing=False)):
        result=fixtures._runner(setup[:3]+(ctx,config,router),executor).run(task,ctx,turn_attempt=0,parent_agent_run_id=parent.id)
    assert len(executor.commands)==len(executor.prompts)==1
    command=executor.commands[0];task_text=executor.prompts[0]
    setting=next(x for x in command if x.startswith('developer_instructions='))
    developer=tomllib.loads(setting)['developer_instructions']
    marker='\n\nCurrent candidate scalar field evidence, computed from the exact candidate JSON above\n'
    prefix,table=task_text.split(marker,1)
    original_candidate=json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(task_text.split('Candidate revision\n',1)[1])[0]
    projected_candidate=json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(prefix.split('Candidate revision\n',1)[1])[0]
    assert original_candidate==projected_candidate and original_candidate['candidate']==c.model_dump(mode='json')
